text: What if the Sun just blinked out, right now?
You wouldn't even know. Not for 8 minutes and 20 seconds.
Then, lights out. Even the Moon goes dark.
No Sun to hold us? Earth flies off in a straight line.
At first, it drops 36 degrees a day.
Three days in, almost everywhere is below freezing.
Ponds freeze in a week. Lakes, in months.
But under the ice, the oceans could stay liquid for years.
By hot sea vents, tiny life could live on rock chemicals, not sunlight.
Later, Earth gets colder than Pluto. Around minus 400 degrees.
Enjoy that sunshine. It's 8 minutes old. Subscribe for more what-ifs, before it blinks out.
